description: Voyager gains the Delta Flyer, clashes again with the Borg and confronts copies, artificial minds and damaged histories as the crew finds increasingly sophisticated ways to shorten or survive the journey.

s05e01.description: Months in a starless void wear down the crew and Janeway until Voyager discovers polluted aliens and the civilization dumping waste into their space.

s05e02.description: Seven's nanoprobes combine with the Doctor's mobile emitter to create a rapidly maturing Borg drone built from 29th-century technology.

s05e03.description: B'Elanna secretly pursues dangerous experiences while Voyager races to build the Delta Flyer and recover a valuable probe from the Malon.

s05e04.description: Voyager discovers Species 8472 running a detailed simulation of Starfleet headquarters to prepare for possible infiltration of the Federation.

s05e05.description: Neelix shields Naomi Wildman from fear after her mother's shuttle disappears, while a holodeck children's story becomes their emotional refuge.

s05e06.description: Fifteen years after Voyager crashes during an experimental flight home, Kim and Chakotay illegally attempt to rewrite the disaster.

s05e07.description: A Borg vinculum forces Seven to manifest personalities of numerous assimilated people, threatening to overwhelm her own identity.

s05e08.description: The Doctor uses a hologram based on a notorious Cardassian physician to save B'Elanna, raising questions about knowledge obtained through atrocities.

s05e09.description: Paris recounts the choices that led to his demotion after he defied Janeway to protect an unstable ocean world.

s05e10.description: Janeway hides telepathic refugees from repeated inspections by the Devore while playing a tense intellectual game with their commanding officer.

s05e11.description: The Doctor discovers Janeway erased memories of an impossible medical choice that once drove his program into a breakdown.

s05e12.description: Photonic aliens mistake a Captain Proton holodeck serial for reality, forcing Janeway to play Queen Arachnia in a deliberately ridiculous war.

s05e13.description: Tuvok and Paris are trapped on a world where time moves rapidly and Tuvok develops a bond with another stranded survivor.

s05e14.description: A massive creature manipulates the crew with visions of their deepest desires, making Voyager willingly fly toward its own digestion.

s05e15-16.description: Janeway raids a Borg vessel for transwarp technology while Seven's unresolved history with the Collective draws her back to the Borg Queen.

s05e17.description: Kim violates regulations through a relationship with a member of a generational ship whose society treats intimacy as a controlled biological bond.

s05e18.description: The duplicate Voyager crew created on the Demon planet begins dissolving and discovers the terrible truth about its identity.

s05e19.description: Chakotay experiences hallucinations linked to aliens in chaotic space while Voyager becomes trapped in a region governed by unfamiliar physics.

s05e20.description: An elite group offers to save Voyager from relentless bounty hunters, but its price is Seven of Nine herself.

s05e21.description: Voyager enters a contaminated Malon freighter headed for disaster while B'Elanna confronts both radiation and her own anger.

s05e22.description: The Doctor teaches Seven how to date and discovers that his clinical exercise has become emotionally personal.

s05e23.description: Janeway recalls an ancestor whose life became tied to a controversial development project at the dawn of the new millennium.

s05e24.description: A future Starfleet timeship recruits Seven across multiple points in Voyager's history to stop a saboteur planting a temporal weapon aboard.

s05e25.description: The Doctor's program becomes host to an intelligent missile determined to complete a mission its creators may no longer want.

s05e26.description: Voyager finds another stranded Starfleet ship whose desperate crew has abandoned Federation ethics to accelerate its route home.
